name: TES 01B · WhatsApp in → Meet's guest contact / Maya brain → reply, escalate, call

parameters.query:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT id FROM airsynk.bookings
  WHERE (NULLIF($3, '') IS NOT NULL AND confirmation_code = NULLIF($3, ''))
     OR (NULLIF($3, '') IS NULL AND status = 'awaiting_guest_contact')
  ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE airsynk.bookings b
SET guest_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($1, ''), b.guest_name, b.guest_first_name),
    guest_phone = NULLIF($2, ''),
    status = 'guest_contact_added',
    updated_at = now()
FROM target WHERE b.id = target.id
RETURNING b.*;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT id FROM airsynk.escalations WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE airsynk.escalations e
SET status = CASE WHEN $1 = 'reject' THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'resolved' END,
    resolution = $1,
    final_reply = CASE WHEN $1 = 'approve' THEN e.draft_reply WHEN $1 = 'custom' THEN NULLIF($2, '') ELSE NULL END,
    resolved_at = now()
FROM target WHERE e.id = target.id
RETURNING e.*;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO airsynk.messages (phone, direction, body, wa_msg_id, contact_name)
  VALUES ($1, 'in', $2, $3, $4)
  ON CONFLICT (wa_msg_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS inserted,
  (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
     SELECT b.*, p.address, p.wifi_name, p.wifi_password, p.checkin_guide, p.house_rules
     FROM airsynk.bookings b LEFT JOIN airsynk.properties p ON p.code = b.listing_code
     WHERE b.guest_phone = $1 ORDER BY b.check_in DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) x) AS booking,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(h ORDER BY h.created_at) FROM (
     SELECT direction, body, created_at FROM airsynk.messages
     WHERE phone = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 12) h), '[]'::json) AS history;
